messages:
alex: Heads up — eastus nodepool is not attaching GPU nodes fast enough. Seeing ~60s start queue per instance and ~30% of spot requests failing with evictions. Some large-batch endpoints returning 504s.

infra-bot: CloudEvents: 1765001201 - InstanceProvisionFailed (eastus-gpu-pool): SpotCapacityNotAvailable. 24 failures in last 4m.

maya: oncall — any quick mitigation? Can we shift traffic to westus or bump min nodes? :eyes: 

jorge: looked at autoscaler logs — scale-up requests are queued then cancelled on spot eviction. snippet:
```
E0310 12:33:21 provisioning.go:142] ProvisionRequest id=pr-9 failed: InstanceCreationFailed: SpotCapacityNotAvailable
E0310 12:33:22 autoscaler.go:88] reconcile delayed: queued=14 pending=7
```

sam: I'm going to manually increase eastus-pool min=6 -> 12 and force on-demand for new machines. running:
```
rgctl nodepool update eastus-pool --min 12 --prefer-spot=false
```

li: we should also pause autoscaler to avoid immediate scale-down thrash once things stabilize. Recommend set autoscaler.cooldown=300s and max_surge=3.

alex: Ok Sam do the command. Maya after bump can you start shifting traffic? Runbook: `lbctl migrate --from=apiv1-eastus --to=apiv1-westus --pct=50` then 100 over 5m.

sam: update done — API reports nodepool min=12, prefer-spot=false. Cloud reports 6 new on-demand instances provisioning.

infra-bot: CloudEvents: 1765001330 - InstancesStarting: 6 new on-demand instances in eastus (ids: i-0a1, i-0b2, i-0c3...).

maya: kicking off gradual shift: `lbctl migrate --from=apiv1-eastus --to=apiv1-westus --pct=50 --step=5m` — starting 50%.

alex: seeing errors drop: 504 -> 502 -> normal-ish. Keep 50% for 10m and watch latency. :thumbsup:

jorge: changed autoscaler config: set cooldown=300, scaleUpDelay=60, disableSpotFallback=true. Pushed config commit: gitops#4567.

li: follow ups for post-incident: investigate why autoscaler queued requests instead of requesting on-demand earlier; add metric alert for provisioning_queue_length > 10 for >2m; add dashboard for spot_fallback_ratio.

sam: opened INC-2026 in PagerDuty: https://pd.local/inc/INC-2026 assigned to eng-infra.

alex: thanks all. We'll keep monitoring the next 30m, then consider rolling min back if stable. :shipit:
